_comment: C3AE fixture manifest. Mirrors models/models/params.py logn16 profile (LogN16_D16_P6: 17 Q primes, 6 P primes — one extra 40-bit prime over the original logn16 so result_ct lands at level ≥ 1 for MAC). `rotation_indices` are raw Orion k_orion values (the positive offsets Orion's evaluator calls RotateNew(ct, +k) with); LoadOrionParams negates them on ingest to fit the signed-label convention on protocol.Params. The list below is a representative subset — the real circuit declares hundreds of k_orion values.
